About the Show

CONNECTING THE COAST'S COMPLETE PROPERTY ECOSYSTEM

The first-of-its-kind trade exhibition in the heart of New Alamein City, this pioneering event serves as an integrated strategic platform connecting leading investors, owners of coastal and hospitality properties, and top real estate developers with premier companies specializing in furniture, interior furnishing, and smart property solutions.

Designed to redefine the property furnishing experience, the exhibition offers an exclusive, all-in-one destination that eliminates the need for lengthy searches and multiple suppliers. From luxury furniture and contemporary décor to smart home management systems and sustainable energy solutions, visitors and investors can discover everything they need under one roof.

More than just an exhibition, this event is a dynamic hub for business connections and investment opportunities, empowering exhibitors to maximize their sales potential and connect directly with a highly targeted audience of serious buyers with immediate purchasing intent.

06 – 09 May 2027New Alamein International Convention & Exhibition Center

THE CONCEPT

From property delivery to property value. A property's journey doesn't end at handover. It needs to be furnished, equipped, connected and continuously upgraded.

Turnkey Show brings these complete sectors together — connecting the growing coastal property market with the brands and solutions that shape its next stage.

THE SHOW PROMISE

One destination. The complete property fit-out. From the first furniture piece to the latest smart-home solution, the show is designed to showcase everything required to create a complete, functional and attractive coastal property.

It connects Furniture & Interiors, Home Appliances, Outdoor Living, Smart Home Technology, Lighting & Accessories, Hospitality Fit-Out, Property Solutions under one roof.

THE VISION

The destination for coastal property solutions. To create the leading platform connecting real estate, design, technology and hospitality — transforming coastal properties into furnished, connected, functional and investment-ready experiences.

THE OPPORTUNITY

From property delivery... to property value. The growth of North Coast & New Alamein is creating more than real estate supply. It is creating a growing ecosystem of Furnished, Equipped, Connected, Operated and Investment-ready properties.
